title: Monitoring and Enforcement of Noise Threshold Compliance of Construction Noise near Residential Estates
what_it_is: Monitoring and Enforcement of Noise Threshold Compliance of Construction Noise near Residential Estates

sections.label: NEA noise enforcement action
sections.summary: NEA enforces against contractors exceeding permissible noise levels, with more severe action for repeated or longer offences, and reviews regulations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA takes strict enforcement action against contractors who exceed the permissible noise levels, with more severe enforcement action typically taken for repeated offences as well as those with a longer duration of time above the permissible noise level.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA will continue to review the regulations including the permissible noise levels to ensure that they remain relevant and effective in protecting public health.

sections.label: Psycho-acoustic factors WHO guidelines
sections.summary: Psycho-acoustic factors reference WHO guidelines, which currently exclude them, though this science is under review.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: When it comes to psycho-acoustic factors, we take reference from the World Health Organization (WHO) guidelines, which currently do not include psycho-acoustic factors, but this is a part of the science that is under review.

sections.label: Penalties for noise regulation offences
sections.summary: Failure to comply with regulations is an offence, liable to fines up to $40,000 and further fines up to $1,000 daily for continuing offences.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: But if they transgress, then we will take further action against them.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: And if they fail to comply with the regulations, they will be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $40,000.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: In cases of continuing offences, further fines not exceeding $1,000 a day, or part thereof, during which the offence continues after conviction.

sections.label: Noise framework averaging and Lmax
sections.summary: The framework balances public health protection with necessary work, using five-minute and 12-hour averaging, and Lmax can be studied with WHO guidelines.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We need to have a balance between the protection of the public health and allowing necessary work to proceed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: And indeed, we do have an averaging of five minutes, but we also have some of the framework where it is averaging over 12 hours.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The current framework requires an average sound level over five minutes and she has asked us about Lmax, which means, not taking into account the time span for a person to be exposed to that sound, but the absolute level for the sound exposure.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: It is indeed something that we can study and we will study together with taking reference from the WHO guidelines that I explained earlier, which is the basis on which we have developed our framework.
